utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—then let’s keep it simple and start with the gate area first. Do we have the patching materials and a tool list ready?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think we’ve got the basics, but I should jot down the tool list before I mix anything up. If you can, send me the materials we still need and I’ll write it down right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — we still need patch mix, a trowel, and a leveling tool for the gate edge.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still hearing it’s coming together, but I don’t have the full details yet. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear where it’s set up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Nell — I’ll hold off until you have the full details. Just let me know where it’s set up and what needs fixing when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’m still waiting on the exact location and the list of what needs fixing, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still on, but I’m waiting on the exact time and drop-off spot before I spread the word. We’re still gathering tools and a few donations, too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so it’s still happening, but the time and drop-off spot aren’t set yet, correct?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s right—once I have the exact time and drop-off spot, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still tracking the repair drive location, and I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries — just let me know where to show up, and I’ll help once you’ve got the location confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I will—I'm still checking, and I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm the repair drive location.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks for the update—Sunday at the community center should be easier to work around. What time on Sunday were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m thinking 10:00 a.m. works best for me. If you have the exact room or drop-off spot, let me know so I can plan it right.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10:00 a.m. works for me too—can you send me the exact room or drop-off spot at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — let’s keep it focused on the urgent safety fixes first. What still needs attention for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I can help with the urgent safety fixes first. What’s still left on the list?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d start with any loose handrails, broken steps, and that uneven path near the common area. If you want, I can help sort the rest into what’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Noah — that’d be a big help. We’re meeting at the corner near the mailbox, by the broken fence, so just swing by whenever you can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll swing by the corner near the mailbox and help out if I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Noah — I really appreciate it. See you at the corner near the mailbox when you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, a few cracks and a loose edge by the gate — mostly patching and a quick leveling, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, that’s the quick version. Patch the cracks, fix the loose gate edge, and level the spots that dipped.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll head to the community center lot and look for the blue tent.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo—I appreciate it. Sunday at the community center should work great, and I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course, Rosa—I’ll bring the tools and lanterns, and I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo—that’s perfect. I’ll make sure the volunteer list is ready for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right—the repair drive. I heard folks are still figuring out what’s needed, but I can pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — that’d help a lot. Just pass along anything you hear, and I’ll have something ready for people to fix.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet—I’ll keep my ears open and let you know as soon as I hear what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m still planning to swing by the repair drive and let everyone know what’s going on. I’ll check what they still need and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’d appreciate it if you could let me know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll stop by and find out what they still need, then let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up—do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard it’s getting a nice little turnout. I’ll swing by after my errands and see if they still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — if you hear what they still need, let me know. I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right—the repair drive. Folks are still figuring out what’s needed, but I can pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I'm out running errands, so I'll check back later and help if they still need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—check back later, and I’ll let you know if they still need another hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll bring the list by later, Rosa. Thanks for organizing the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still tracking the repair drive location, but I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal. I appreciate you keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli — the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now. Do you have a list of what still needs fixing so I can match it with volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rosa. I don’t have a full list handy yet, but I know the cracks by the gate and that loose edge still need attention.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, that helps—I’ll note the gate cracks and the loose edge. If you think of anything else, send it my way and I’ll line up the right volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara—I'm still waiting on the exact location, but it sounds like things are coming together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Nell — we’re still finalizing the spot, but I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—thanks, Mara. I’ll keep an eye out for the update on the location.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — just start by the gate and patch those cracks first. If you finish that, we can take a quick look at the loose edge too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll start by the gate and patch the cracks first. If I finish जल्दी enough, I’ll take a quick look at the loose edge too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — keep it simple and let me know when the gate cracks are done. We can check the loose edge after that.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out, I just need to jot down the details before I forget them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Oren! We’re meeting by the mailbox corner, and if you can bring work gloves or a screwdriver, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — mailbox corner, and I’ll bring work gloves and a screwdriver. I’m writing that down right now so I don’t lose it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I’ve got the tools and lanterns covered for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Cleo — that covers a big part of it. We still need help patching the cracks and leveling the loose edge by the gate on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help with that too on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what do you need me to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard they still need a few basic tools and some lanterns—do you know if there’s anything else missing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can check, but I’d guess spare batteries and a roll of tape might help too. I’ll bring what I have and ask around for anything else they’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks for the update, Leo — Sunday at the community center works better with the school schedule. What time is the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday at 10 AM should work. Meet at the community center entrance.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll plan around that and let the other parents know. See you at the community center entrance at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it’s mostly a few neighborhood fixes and organizing the drop-offs for the repair drive. I’m still planning to swing by and let everyone know what’s going on.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — can you tell me exactly which spots need fixing and where people should gather for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can point out the main spots that need fixing, and people should gather near the community center entrance for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, it’s still on — I think we’ve got the drop-off by the mailbox corner, but I’m blanking on the exact date right now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s still on and the drop-off is by the mailbox corner, but the exact date is still up in the air, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’s right — the date’s the part I’m still fuzzy on. I’ll check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—can you send me the most urgent items so I can help match volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — the most urgent items are the broken handrail by the community stairs, the loose porch step near the rec room, and the leaking pipe in the shared laundry area. I’ll send the full details so we can match volunteers quickly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — I’ll start matching volunteers for those three first.
